title: 第5章 不卑不亢张邋遢第6章 自作自受李天娇
content_zh:
;;
日落，皎月东升。
后院湖边，两道身影坐在那里，湖水倒映着月光，波光粼粼，静中带动。
“老张”
李子夜看着湖面，开口道，“连你也没有办法吗？”
“没有。”
张邋遢摇了摇头，道，“那慕尧已开启了第二神藏，而你却是一座神藏未开，差距，太大。”
“我家有银子。”
李子夜轻声道，“要多少，有多少，神兵利器，战衣宝甲应有尽有。”
“那也不可能，除非”
张邋遢注视着湖面，平静道，“你今夜派人宰了他。”
“有道理。”
李子夜想了想，旋即很是认真地点了点头，道，“老张，开个价。”
“呵。”
张邋遢淡淡一笑，道，“老头子我可没有那么下作。”
“一百坛百花酿。”李子夜开价道。
“那是大商的皇子。”
张邋遢冷笑道，“你觉得我老头子傻吗？”
“二百。”李子夜继续加价。
“绝无可能。”张邋遢摇头道。

“五百。”李子夜直接起价。
“我不喜杀人。”张邋遢沉默，片刻后，开口道。
“一千坛，再加上五百坛上好的女儿红。”李子夜报出了自己的底价。
“成交。”
张邋遢起身，迈步朝外面走去。
“老张。”
后方，李子夜开口喊道。
张邋遢转过身，问道，“怎么，后悔了？”
“那倒不是。”
李子夜面露笑意，道，“不过，别把人打死了，现在还不是和皇室彻底撕破脸的时候，让他躺上几天即可。”
“没出息。”
张邋遢冷笑一声，转身离去。
夜深。
悦来客栈，一间客房内，慕尧坐在烛火下，静静擦拭着自己的配剑。
床榻前，小厮铺好床铺，开口道，“殿下，早些休息吧。”
“嗯。”
慕尧点头，应道，“你先下去吧。”
“是。”
小厮领命，刚要离开，又停下了步子，面露担忧之色，道，“殿下，真不用联系渝州城的官府吗，奴才担心那李家会对殿下不利。”
“不会。”

Sunset, the bright moon rises in the east.
By the lake in the backyard, two figures were sitting there. The lake reflected the moonlight, sparkling and moving in silence.
"Lao Zhang"
Li Ziye looked at the lake and said, "Can't you even do anything?"
"No."
Zhang Sloppy shook his head and said, "Mu Yao has opened the second divine treasure, but you have not yet opened the first divine treasure. The gap is too big."
"My family has money."
Li Ziye said softly, "As many as you want, there are all kinds of magic weapons, weapons, battle clothes, and armor."
"That's impossible, unless"
Zhang Slutty stared at the lake and said calmly, "Send someone to kill him tonight."
"That makes sense."
Li Ziye thought for a while, then nodded seriously and said, "Old Zhang, make a price."
"Heh."
Zhang Slutty smiled lightly and said, "Old man, I'm not that mean."
"One hundred jars of hundreds of flowers brewing." Li Ziye offered the price.
"That's the prince of Dashang."
Zhang Ruo sneered, "Do you think my old man is stupid?"
"Two hundred." Li Ziye continued to increase the price.
"Absolutely impossible." Zhang Slutty shook his head.
"Five hundred." Li Ziye started the price directly.
"I don't like killing people." Zhang Sloppy was silent, and after a moment, he said.
"One thousand jars, plus five hundred jars of fine Nuerhong." Li Ziye reported his base price.
"Deal."
Zhang Slutty stood up and walked outside.
"Old Zhang."
From behind, Li Ziye shouted.
Zhang Sloppy turned around and asked, "What, do you regret it?"
"That's not true."
Li Ziye smiled and said, "But don't beat the person to death. Now is not the time to completely break up with the royal family. Just let him lie down for a few days."
"It's worthless."
Zhang sloppy sneered, turned and left.
Late at night.
In a guest room at Yuelai Inn, Mu Yao sat under the candlelight, quietly wiping his sword.
In front of the bed, the servant made the bed and said, "Your Highness, please rest early."
"Yeah."
Mu Yao nodded and responded, "You go down first."
"Yes."
The servant took the order and was about to leave when he stopped again with a worried look on his face and said, "Your Highness, do you really need to contact the officials in Yuzhou City? I am worried that the Li family will be detrimental to Your Highness."
"No."
